description: AICTIONBOT™ category sorter by KULIC Advisory (tool 44), built on the Execution Toolkit templates T09 (category strategy) and T24 (data self-audit). Takes order or booking lines (text, supplier, amount) and assigns each to KULIC Advisory's own category tree of 30 categories in nine groups (materials and goods, technical and maintenance, logistics, IT and telecoms, building and energy, office, fleet and travel, services, finance and insurance) by keywords. Returns spend per group and category, rows left open for manual assignment and uncertain rows. A basis for the spend cube and the category profile in businesses without categories. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: Rows: text (order or booking text), supplier, amount. German column names work too.
